items.title: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) Expands ADC Pipeline As Late Stage Trial Results Impress
items.summary: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) agreed a multi-program Antibody-Drug Conjugate collaboration with Hansoh Pharmaceutical, targeting oncology assets beyond China. The partners plan to co-develop and potentially commercialise a portfolio of ADC candidates, combining Roche platforms with Hansoh discovery capabilities.
